data.notes:
Sessions 1 to 5: genealogy of thought. Leading questions: What is empire to us? What are different ways of theoretically approaching ‘empire’? What possibilities does it open to foreground materials? What are the theoretical currents on material thinking? How do they differ and give us different outcomes/ways of analyzing?

BREAK for Eid

6 tot 10: into the world. Leading questions: diversify topics and focuses in material thinking, today and in history. Link readings/viewings back to part I. Develop your own research attitude, Start to think of your own project.
